senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (हुर्च्छति)
To be crooked, (literally or figuratively,) to be fraudulent.
2 To retreat, to hide or abscond.

m. (-वः)
A jackal.
E.
हू a cry of fear or wrath, and रव, sound.

n. (-नं)
Crookedness, (literal or figurative,) craft, cunning.
E.
हुर्च्छ to be crooked, ल्युट् aff.
